manifest.source: UrbanSound8K (Salamon et al. 2014; Zenodo 1203745), all 10 official folds, 10 classes, clips of at most 4 s padded to 4 s; mixed sample rates and bit depths decoded by the app's WAV decoder (clips it cannot read are skipped and listed); HuBERT-base (torchaudio, layer 6, mean over time) embeddings for the label and shift checks; pixel and shared-pattern checks on 32x32 spectrogram images; attacks applied to raw 16 kHz waveforms
manifest.policy: New held-out dataset: nothing was tuned on UrbanSound8K; the detector is frozen at 1f2c439 and the result is quoted once. Never edit this file in place: create a new benchmark_id for any change.
